top_examples.hook: My aunt tasted our family recipe and asked why I had changed Grandma's secret ingredient. I hadn't.
top_examples.premise: A woman discovers her sister has been secretly replacing sentimental family recipes with easier versions before a reunion cookbook is printed.
top_examples.title: Someone Rewrote Grandma's Recipes

top_examples.hook: My girlfriend was getting refunds from restaurants after dates that I paid for.
top_examples.premise: A man notices his girlfriend keeps receiving tiny refunds after every restaurant date they take together.
top_examples.title: She Got Money Back After Every Date We Had

top_examples.hook: I thought my sister was stealing our mother's card for takeout. The delivery notes made me feel terrible for accusing her.
top_examples.premise: A woman thinks her sister is secretly using their mother's credit card for restaurant deliveries until the delivery notes reveal their mother has been ordering meals for an elderly neighbor who stopped cooking after surgery.
top_examples.title: I Thought My Sister Was Stealing Mom's Card

top_examples.hook: The headphones I sold for eighty dollars came back online as a 'secret prototype' for nine hundred.
top_examples.premise: A man discovers the expensive headphones he sold online are back on the marketplace listed as a rare unreleased prototype.
top_examples.title: My Used Headphones Became a $900 Secret Prototype

top_examples.hook: At my cousin's wedding, three relatives accused me of eating Grandpa's special meal before he even sat down.
top_examples.premise: A man is publicly accused of taking the last reserved meal at a wedding before the bride's elderly grandfather can eat.
top_examples.title: Everyone Thought I Ate Grandpa's Wedding Dinner
